verdict.rationale: Parsec's own pricing page lists keyboard and mouse support, and guests can take control of the host. Full Wacom pressure and tilt support suggests high-fidelity input forwarding. However, nothing documents scroll handling or confirms that input is injected on the host as native OS events. Missing for 10: explicit scroll-input forwarding, documentation that input arrives as native host events, hands-on corroboration of input fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
